- SSO: you mentioned Okta — can you confirm whether you want SAML-only or SCIM provisioning for user sync? If SCIM, we'll need an admin token from your side.
- Admin list: please confirm full names + emails for the two admins (default will be org admin scope).
- IP allowlist: do you have a set of static IP ranges for your backend / CI (for webhooks)? If not, we can skip allowlist and rely on signature verification.
- API key usage: do you want a single prod-service-key shared by backend instances, or per-service keys? We recommend one service key per environment for rotation simplicity.

Proposed near-term plan/timeline:
- Today (Mon): confirm admin emails + SSO choice -> I provision tenants and create projects
- Day 1 after provisioning: create keys and share secure link (DocuSign / encrypted share)
- Day 2: import users (via CSV or SCIM), verify SSO, run smoke tests (generate tokens, call health endpoint)

Could we schedule a 30-min kickoff on Mon 13 Apr at 10:30am PT? If not, offer two alternatives. I've created a shared onboarding doc with a checklist and meeting link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3NovamedOnboarding
